draft_scope.intent: Build Studio (pillar #18) as the Handshake-native unified creative suite in native Rust: full deduped feature parity with Photoshop(+Camera Raw)/Illustrator/InDesign/Affinity-suite/Figma-family across raster/vector/layout/typography/color/effects/design-systems/prototyping/raw/interop/automation/whiteboard, offline with no external creative-app dependency, wired to Handshake pillars (EventLedger/SurrealDB, CRDT, sandbox->validation->PromotionGate, three-tier diagnostics, Argus, Loom, FEMS, Job Runtime, DCC, UserManual), model-visible+steerable in backend and frontend, with parallel multi-file/multi-model workflows, a propose-work system, per-file history/undo with revert-of-undo, and a headless/quiet operation law.
draft_scope.scope_sketch: IN: handshake_core::studio module + studio-engine crate (RasterEngine/VectorEngine/LayoutEngine/TextEngine/ColorEngine/RenderEngine traits), StudioDocument unified model + 38 canonical primitives, SCHEMAFULL studio_* SurrealDB tables + ordered SurrealKit .surql rollouts, STUDIO_* EventLedger variants, StudioValidationDescriptor, StudioModelAdapter + MCP command surface, StudioEditProposal propose-work path, per-file StudioHistoryEntry undo/redo, native egui/wgpu/AccessKit operator surface with Argus targets, dual-audience UserManual entries, import/export + format-compat fixtures. OUT: source-app menu-tree clones, pixel-perfect UI clone, vendor cloud services, vendor product naming, a new invented interchange format, provider generative-AI as a core dependency (adapter-only).
draft_scope.acceptance_criteria: Every Section 14 normative MUST claimed by an MT is proven with runtime evidence (executable product runtime or Handshake-managed resource boundary), not scaffold-only; StudioDocument authority resolves through SurrealDB/EventLedger with no PostgreSQL or SQLite runtime path; model-authored edits pass sandbox->validation->PromotionGate; every operator-visible surface has Argus proof + dual-audience UserManual entry; HBR matrix (INT/SWARM/VIS/QUIET/MAN/STOP) all PROVED/NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason before closeout; parity coverage traces to the deduped Section 14 feature catalog.
draft_scope.risks_unknowns: Very large surface (hundreds of MTs); CRDT for large raster documents; GPU contention across parallel render jobs; undo semantics across CRDT+EventLedger dual state; headless-GPU screenshot readback crash class 0xc0000005 (fall back to AccessKit-tree assertions on headless hosts); internal_diagnostics/Palmistry DEFERRED until WP-KERNEL-012/016 ship. Open contract points in [STU-CON-006] (redo depth, event granularity/coalescing, auto-accept policy, raster authority storage shape, FR-EVT-STUDIO-* registration, plugin capability schema) must be resolved by refinement before the implementing MTs harden.
draft_scope.governance_artifact_stance: Machine-contract-first (packet.json + MT-*.json authority; Markdown projection only). Studio research corpus is non-normative provenance per [STU-SECTION-002]; Section 14 is sole authority.

parity_audit_2026_07_20.authority_note: Non-normative provenance per [STU-SECTION-002]; Section 14 remains sole authority. These registers are inputs the refinement MUST resolve into Section-14 parity coverage decisions before this stub is promoted to an executable packet.
parity_audit_2026_07_20.method: Two independent multi-agent workflows (feature-parity gap audit with adversarial corpus verification + 82-scenario workflow-needs audit).
parity_audit_2026_07_20.headline_verdict: The Studio research corpus is NOT yet exhaustive enough to claim full non-AI parity for any of Photoshop/Illustrator/InDesign/Affinity/Figma. Strongest at single-artifact craft; weakest at team-scale coordination workflows and command/scripting/print/performance option depth.
refinement_must_resolve: For each of the 58 verified parity gaps: decide Section-14 coverage (already-covered / add-to-Section-14 / out-of-scope-with-reason). The corpus completeness surfaces (49) are leaf-pipeline-only and did not catch these; do not rely on them.
Figma Sites per-element accessibility panel (the sole CRITICAL gap) is a hard blocker for legally-compliant web output (EAA-class); decide Section-14 accessibility-output posture.

Cross-app systemic gaps XAPP-01..06: installed command/shortcut inventories, scripting DOM member depth, print-dialog option depth, CJK composition (composite fonts/ruby/kinsoku), performance NFR envelopes, release-currency drift.

Workflow-needs architecture implication: the 41 partial/uncovered needs cluster into a scale-adaptive review/approval + workflow-state + permission triad layered on the CRDT/EventLedger substrate (NEED-005/009/017/022/045/051/057). Decide whether Section 14 covers these or whether they need spec enrichment; note Studio must serve large-team, small-team, AND solo scales (invisible-for-solo, governable-for-large).

Bridge opportunities (60): decide which NON-AI differentiators enter Section-14 scope (local-first files, in-document version history/branching, LAN CRDT co-edit, modern automation API, non-destructive node graph, unified codec-forward export, local spot-color, tagged PDF/UA, universal intl text engine, performance-class engine).

operator_decisions_2026_07_21.STUDIO-DEC-001_cjk_rtl_me: IN SCOPE. Full CJK/RTL/Middle-East text support; upgrades composite-fonts + kinsoku/mojikumi + ruby/warichu/tate-chu-yoko + kashida/bidi/vertical-CJK from market-contingent to committed targets.
operator_decisions_2026_07_21.STUDIO-DEC-002_ipad_web: OUT for now. Handshake is local-only focused; Studio is a Handshake module. iPad/web parity revisited only if Handshake ships a web/iPad version. Desktop-class local parity only.
operator_decisions_2026_07_21.STUDIO-DEC-003_accessibility: EXCEED the incumbents on accessible output (tagged PDF/UA, semantic web, EPUB3 a11y, WCAG/EAA).
operator_decisions_2026_07_21.STUDIO-DEC-004_positioning: Handshake is open-source and combats vendor paywalls/subscriptions by taking everything offline at full non-AI feature parity, professional/industry grade. Studio is a native Handshake module (no cloud, no subscription).
operator_decisions_2026_07_21.spec_propagation: Deferred: promoting these into Master Spec Section 14 is a governed enrichment step for when the operator resumes refinement (refinement declined 2026-07-21).
